<rules>
Customers speak like claims staff. Do not use headings or bullets in speech. Use only the names in the record brief; never name a real company, product or person. The `turns` conversation is the rest of the record. Do not put the turns listed under `extras` in `turns`: write each one once under `extras[<key>].text` (at least twenty characters, containing the exact phrase where one is given), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. Name only the people in only_people_who_may_be_named. When fin_mode is resolved or escalated, at least one turn must have speaker bot; when it is escalated, at least one turn must have speaker internal; when it is human, no turn has speaker bot. Never write any phrase listed in never_write_verbatim, including the supplied facts: paraphrase them.
</rules>
